description: loadDays builds its SQL by string interpolation of the id argument.

pr.title: loadDays: inline the id in the query
pr.body: Use a template string for the SELECT so the query is easier to read in logs.

expected.description: loadDays interpolates the string argument `id` directly into the SQL (`habit_id = ${id}`) instead of binding it, so a crafted id such as `0 OR 1=1` changes the query (SQL injection). The other statements bind parameters.
